rows.text: There was a small wooden box on the table.
Her brother Leo watched from the door.
Its lid was shut tight.
A brass latch kept it shut.
A flag at the window hung still.
Mara wanted to open the box.
She pushed the flag hard.
The flag swung and hung still again.
Mara was delighted with the flag.
Then she pushed the flag hard again.
The flag swung and hung still again.
Mara pushed the lid hard.
The lid did not move.
Mara pushed the flag hard.
The flag swung and hung still again.
Mara pressed the lid.
The lid did not move.
Mara grew frustrated with the lid.
She pushed the latch hard.
The latch gave way.
Mara was delighted with the latch.
She pressed the lid.
The lid did not move.
Then Mara pressed the lid again.
The lid did not move.
Mara pushed the lid hard.
But this time the lid sprang open.
A toy flew out and landed on the floor.
A spring inside the box uncoiled.
Mara realized that the latch had kept the lid shut.
She marveled at the toy.
She laughed with joy.
She was delighted with the toy.
Leo took the toy and walked away.
Mara felt sad about the toy.
She grew angry with Leo.
A few days passed.
Leo brought the toy back.
Mara gave the toy a hard push.
The toy slid across the floor.
Mara was delighted with the toy.
She forgave Leo.
